Empirical Financial Services Has Cut Its Patterson Companies (PDCO) Holding by $304,076; As Canadian Nat Res LTD (CNQ) Stock Value Rose, Ci Global Investments Has Upped Holding 
February 8, 2018 - By Vivian Park 
Ci Global Investments Inc increased its stake in Canadian Nat Res Ltd (CNQ) by 56.92% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ci Global Investments Inc bought 374,550 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.36% with the market. The institutional investor held 1.03 million shares of the oil & gas production company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $34.58 million, up from 657,975 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ci Global Investments Inc who had been investing in Canadian Nat Res Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $36.34 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 3.91% or $1.25 during the last trading session, reaching $30.68. About 5.51M shares traded or 152.81% up from the average. Canadian Natural Resources Limited (NYSE:CNQ) has risen 10.32% since February 8, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 6.38% the S&P500. 
Empirical Financial Services Llc decreased its stake in Patterson Companies Inc (PDCO) by 53.35% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Empirical Financial Services Llc sold 8,002 shares as the company’s stock declined 2.93% while stock markets rallied. The institutional investor held 6,998 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $270,000, down from 15,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Empirical Financial Services Llc who had been investing in Patterson Companies Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $3.14B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.40% or $0.48 during the last trading session, reaching $33.85. About 1.16 million shares traded. Patterson Companies, Inc. (NASDAQ:PDCO) has declined 4.97% since February 8, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 21.67% the S&P500. 
Ci Global Investments Inc, which manages about $9.58 billion and $4.99 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Schlumberger Ltd (NYSE:SLB) by 394,349 shares to 2,224 shares, valued at $155,000 in 2017Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Lockheed Martin Corp (NYSE:LMT) by 11,216 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 12,253 shares, and cut its stake in Unitedhealth Group Inc (NYSE:UNH).
